name: Joseph Gomez

career_stints.note: Championship first-team breakthrough before his July 2015 move to Liverpool, per a Transfermarkt competition breakdown. The combined '1 assist/goal' figure attached to this stint in the fetched source text was ambiguous (unclear whether it means a goal or an assist), so goals/assists are omitted here rather than guessed.

All-competitions Liverpool totals per Transfermarkt (fetched 2026-08-10, current through the completed 2025/26 season): 20,254 minutes since joining 1 July 2015. Competition breakdown: Premier League 170 apps/7 assists, Champions League 46 apps/2 assists, FA Cup 21 apps, EFL Cup 22 apps, Europa League 12 apps/3 assists. The positions_played split (70% CB / 30% RB) is an approximate characterization based on his listed positions and long-standing rotational CB/RB usage, not a source-confirmed per-position minutes split -- flagged as an estimate.

injury_status.description: Muscular injury sustained in the opening 10 minutes of Liverpool's pre-season friendly win over Sunderland (Nashville), late July 2026
injury_status.expected_return: Manager Iraola estimated 'some weeks'; confirmed to miss the Premier League season-opener vs Newcastle United on 23 August 2026. No firmer date given as of 2026-08-10 research.

Basis is liverpool_recent_minutes despite a thin recent sample (21 PL apps but only 597 minutes in 2025/26 -- heavy late-cameo/impact-sub usage, well below the schema's ~900-minute 'substantial sample' guidance) because there is no viable alternative: his last club before Liverpool was over a decade ago. Confidence kept low (0.45) to reflect this mismatch rather than presenting the estimate as solid.

Liverpool's longest-serving outfield player, but game time has shrunk sharply in recent seasons (just 6 Premier League starts in each of the last two campaigns, per reporting) as the club's defensive pecking order shifted around him.

His Liverpool future is genuinely uncertain: contract runs to 30 June 2027; as of 2026-08-10 research he has publicly said 'anything can happen' regarding a summer exit, with reported interest from AC Milan, Newcastle, Crystal Palace and Aston Villa. He remains on the books per the squad file, and England's transfer window doesn't close until 1 September 2026, so this could still change before the season is fully underway -- worth re-checking.
